# Kaique Lima - Complete Profile

URL: https://ike-dev.com.br

---

## About

Kaique Lima (Kaique de Godoi Lima) is a Senior Frontend Engineer with 9+ years of experience (programming since 2017, full focus on frontend since 2018). He specializes in scalable architectures for high-performance e-commerce and admin panels using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

He has been embedded in large Brazilian brands as an outsourced engineer through Leanwork: Centauro, Riachuelo, FarmaciasApp (Grupo SC), Sinerlog, and Wake Commerce. Focus areas: performance, security, usability, and SEO.

Highlight: greenfield frontend for one of Brazil's largest pharmacy marketplaces — 15,000+ stores integrated and a 300% increase in monthly sales in the first year of operation.

## Professional Experience

Kaique has had two formal employers: Elitesoft (2017–2018) and Leanwork (2018–present). At Leanwork he is allocated as a consultant to different brands; each role below is a distinct allocation within the same company.

### Wake Commerce (via Leanwork) — Tech Lead Frontend
- Period: Sep 2025 – Present
- URL: https://wake.tech/wake-commerce/
- Highlights:
  - Led third-party integrations (Serasa, Hero Seguros, Tuna Pagamentos) on the Wake Commerce platform
  - Focus on secure, scalable architecture (Go-Live preparation)
- Tech: JavaScript, HTML/CSS, TailwindCSS

### Sinerlog (via Leanwork) — Tech Lead Frontend
- Period: Jan 2025 – Aug 2025
- URL: https://sinerlog.global/
- Highlights:
  - Led frontend developers delivering 4 admin panels and 1 multi-tenant e-commerce simultaneously
  - Created a proprietary UI Registry based on shadcn/ui architecture, standardizing components across the company
  - Restructured CI/CD pipelines for multiple environments (HML/PRD) with Docker
- Tech: React, Next.js, Vite.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Shadcn UI, Figma, CI/CD, Docker

### FarmaciasApp – Grupo SC (via Leanwork) — Senior Frontend Engineer
- Period: Jan 2023 – Dec 2024
- URL: https://farmaciasapp.com.br/
- Highlights:
  - Greenfield marketplace frontend with React, Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Shadcn UI
  - Integrated a catalog of 15,000+ stores
  - Aggressive Core Web Vitals and SEO work; contributed to a 300% increase in monthly sales in year one
  - SSR/ISR with Next.js for indexing thousands of product pages
- Tech: React, Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, AdobeXD, CI/CD, Shadcn UI, SEO

### Riachuelo – Fanlab & Carter's (via Leanwork) — Pleno Frontend Engineer
- Period: Jan 2021 – Dec 2022
- URL: https://riachuelo.com.br/
- Highlights:
  - Digital fronts for Fanlab and Carter's within the Riachuelo ecosystem
  - Loading performance and modular componentization
- Tech: React, Next.js, TypeScript, AdobeXD, JavaScript

### Centauro (via Leanwork) — Pleno Frontend Engineer
- Period: Jan 2019 – Dec 2020
- URL: https://centauro.com.br/
- Highlights:

  - Sustained high-traffic e-commerce
- Tech: React, AdobeXD, JavaScript

### Leanwork — Junior Frontend Engineer
- Period: Jul 2018 – Dec 2018
- URL: https://leanwork.com.br/
